description: Toolbars group related actions in a docked or floating container.

tags.devx:
- Compose `IconButton` children or pass `actions` for a data-driven action group.
- `maxVisible` moves the remaining actions into an automatic overflow menu;
  `responsive` derives the visible count from the toolbar width.
- `more` customizes the default overflow trigger and `renderMore` replaces its
  visual rendering while keeping the menu behavior.
- The generated overflow menu chooses above/below or left/right from the
  toolbar orientation and the trigger's viewport half; `morePosition` can
  force a placement.
- Descendant `IconButton` controls keep rounded press feedback in floating
  toolbars.
- Use `variant="floating"` for a compact surface and
  `orientation="vertical"` for a vertical action group.
tags.a11y:
- Renders `role="toolbar"` and applies `aria-orientation="vertical"` for
  vertical layouts.
- The overflow trigger has an accessible label and the generated menu uses
  the labels from each action.
- Provide `accessibleLabel` or an `aria-labelledby` reference to name the
  toolbar; label each child control according to its own component API.
tags.limitations:
- `actions` and `children` are alternative content modes; `actions` takes precedence.
- The toolbar does not implement roving focus or arrow-key navigation for its
  direct children. The overflow menu owns menu-item keyboard navigation.
- Composition children remain consumer-owned; use `IconButton size="small"`
  for the 48dp toolbar slots shown in the Material 3 design.

className.name: className
className.description: Root classes (string), static element classes (object), or state-aware element classes (function).

orientation.name: orientation
orientation.description: Layout axis for the toolbar's children.

accessibleLabel.name: accessibleLabel
accessibleLabel.description:
Accessible name applied to the toolbar container.
Prefer this prop for cross-framework parity; `aria-labelledby` remains
available through the framework's native attributes.

maxVisible.name: maxVisible
maxVisible.description: Maximum number of non-pinned actions shown in the toolbar.

responsive.name: responsive
responsive.description: Measures the toolbar and reserves one action slot for overflow when needed.

itemWidth.name: itemWidth
itemWidth.description: Estimated width of one action slot when `responsive` is enabled.

more.name: more
more.description: Presentation options for the automatically rendered overflow trigger.

morePosition.name: morePosition
morePosition.description: Position of the generated overflow menu relative to the More trigger. `auto` follows the toolbar orientation and the trigger's viewport half.

onMoreOpenChange.name: onMoreOpenChange
onMoreOpenChange.description: Notifies consumers when the generated overflow menu opens or closes.

renderMore.name: renderMore
renderMore.description: Replaces the default overflow trigger while retaining the overflow menu.
